She works like an overclocked machine, bypassing three levels of corrupted firewall and forcing the Inverse Fractal sequence onto Jora’s dampener field controls. Her fingers move with surgical precision across the interface pads, programming a patterned wave meant to ride the edge of dimensional stress.

"Shunting now," Ren gasps out, her voice tight as she engages the power routing. The hum in Command Level One surges instantly, climbing beyond the noise floor into a high-pitched, sustained whine—a sound that is too perfect, too mathematically clean to be random interference.

The EMDF, now repurposed to carry the frequency packet, instantly becomes a high-power amplifier. The raw informational wave races toward Node Three through Jora's clamps. It is not an energy blast, but a dense, complex pattern of pure logic—the inverse geometry designed to disrupt the Entity’s recursive replication.

The protective polymer clamps strain and shatter under the resulting energetic recoil.

Jora’s armor is overwhelmed by the dimensional pressure and collapses against the viewport, her struggle abruptly halted. Ren stares at her console as every gauge spikes into oblivion; the power grid has been compromised beyond repair. Helena screams—a single, sharp sound of total failure—as she sees not just a breach, but the violent end of all attempts at tactical control.
